title: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (ﷺ)

duas.english: Whoever prays for Allah's blessings upon me once, will be blessed for it by Allah ten times.
duas.arabic: مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ صَلاَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِهَا عَشْراً

duas.source: Abu Dawud 2/218, Ahmad 2/367. Al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih Abu Dawud 2/383
duas.english: Do not make my grave a place of ritual celebration, but pray for Allah's blessings upon me, for your blessings reach me from wherever you are.
duas.arabic: لاَ تَجْعَلُوا قَبْرِي عِيداً وَصَلُّوا عَلَيَّ؛ فَإِنَّ صَلاَتَكُم تَبْلُغُنِي حَيْثُ كُنْتُمْ

duas.source: At-Tirmidhi 5/551 and others. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/177 and Sahihul-Jarai' As-Saghir 3/25
duas.english: The miser is the one in whose presence I am mentioned yet does not pray for Allah's blessings upon me.
duas.arabic: الْبَخِيلُ مَنْ ذُكِرْتُ عِنْدَهُ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيَّ

duas.source: An-Nasa'i, Al-Hakim 2/421. Al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih An-Nasa'i 1/274
duas.english: Indeed Allah has angels who roam the earth and they convey to me the greetings (or prayers of peace) of my Ummah (nation).
duas.arabic: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَلاَئِكَةً سَيَّاحِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يُبَلِّغُونِي مِنْ أُمَّتِي السَّلاَمَ

duas.source: Abu Dawud (no. 2041). Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Abu Dawud 1/383
duas.english: No one sends greetings (or prayers of peace) upon me but Allah returns my soul to me so that I may return his greetings.
duas.arabic: مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَيَّ إِلاَّ رَدَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيَّ رُوحِيَ حَتَّى أَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمَ
